name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that stops them from choking on huge amounts of raw file and log data, and remembers what you were working on between sessions.
buyer: An engineering manager at a software company whose developers burn through their AI coding tool's usage limits every day and want it to go further per session.
business_use_cases: A software consultancy installs it across its developers' AI coding tools to cut context usage, so paid AI subscriptions cover more work per seat.
A dev tools vendor bundles it into their own AI coding product to differentiate on 'remembers your whole project' instead of restarting cold each session.
An engineering team uses the persistent session memory as a lightweight stand-in for proper project documentation handoff between developers.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version with a team dashboard showing context savings and session history, sold per seat.
Paid onboarding/configuration service for engineering teams adopting it across many repos and AI tools.

steal_this: This is plumbing for developers using AI coding tools, not a product end customers would ever see or pay for directly — it's a tool for tool-builders.
